name: Triton paper: An intermediate language and compiler for tiled neural network computation
notes: Original Triton paper by Tillet, Kung, Cox (Harvard). Describes Triton-C (C-like language), Triton-IR (LLVM-based IR), and Triton-JIT compiler. Demonstrates matmul and convolution on par with cuBLAS/cuDNN. The tile-centric approach is the key abstraction.
